column3: Lesson four. Missing a day is not the end.
Later in season one, Jinwoo forgets his daily quest, right before his hardest fight.
In the middle of that battle, the system pulls him into the penalty zone. And that detour is what gives him the chance to recover, come back stronger, and win.
Real life is less dramatic. But the London habit study found something just as useful. Missing a single day did not materially affect how the habit formed.
What hurts isn't the miss. It's the story you tell yourself after it. I already broke it, so what's the point.
One missed day is a penalty zone. Survive it, and go back to the quest tomorrow.
